name: kit
description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace for authoring tools — BookBank books, CourseBank courses, and more, one plugin per sibling directory. Each plugin publishes to your own repo; nothing is tied to one account.

plugins.name: bookbank
plugins.description: Skills and tools for authoring BookBank books: research-and-write a topic into a self-contained HTML book, publish to your own GitHub Pages library, and turn a GitHub Issue into a generated book.

plugins.name: coursebank
plugins.description: Skills and tools for building CourseBank courses: generate an interactive training course from a source corpus (a repo, docs, or policies) as an installable offline-first PWA with lessons, checkpoints, tracked progress, and a completion certificate. Requires the bookbank plugin for its craft skills.
